```{r}
    library(networkdata)
    library(igraph)
    g <- flo_marriage + flo_business
    g <- subgraph(g, which(degree(g) != 0))
```


```{r}
   prestige.sim <- function(x, alpha = 0, beta = 0) {
      A <- as.matrix(as_adjacency_matrix(x))
      A.p <- A %*% A 
      A.q <- A %*% (1 - A)  
      S <- A.p / (A.p + A.q + t(A.q))
      W <- A * S^alpha * (1 - S)^beta
      s <- abs(eigen(W)$vectors[, 1])
      names(s) <- rownames(A)
      return(s/max(s))
   }
```


```{r}
    bon <- prestige.sim(g, alpha = 0, beta = 0)
    ace <- prestige.sim(g, alpha = 0, beta = 1)
    ol1 <- prestige.sim(g, alpha = 1, beta = 0)
    ol2 <- prestige.sim(g, alpha = 0.25, beta = 0.75)
    sort.vec <- function(x) {
        x <- data.frame(Node = names(x), Score = as.numeric(x))
        x <- x[order(x$Score, decreasing = TRUE), ]
        return(x)
        }
    
```


```{r}
    library(kableExtra)
    library(here)
    eig.dat <- data.frame(sort.vec(bon), sort.vec(ace), sort.vec(ol1), sort.vec(ol2))
    save_kable(kbl(eig.dat,
        format = "latex", booktabs = TRUE, linesep = "",
        row.names = FALSE, align = rep(c("l", "c"), 4),
        digits = 3, col.names = c("Node", "Bonacich", "Node", "Eig./Dis", "Node", "Eig./Sim", "Node", "Eig./Both"),
        caption = "Top Ten Eigenvector-Based Scores for the Medici Network.") %>%    kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("hover", "condensed", "responsive")), file = here("main.tex"))
```
